name: Mount Veeder Winery / Franciscan Estate - Napa CA

fieldNotes.facilityResolution: Roster coords (38.298851, -122.282898) landed on the downtown Napa tasting room (930 3rd St). The actual Mount Veeder estate is the hillside vineyard at 1999 Mt Veeder Rd, Napa — geocoded via Google Geocoding API to 38.3606213, -122.4017761 (ROOFTOP). Audited the estate.
fieldNotes.facilityNature: This is a hillside vineyard estate, not a freight/production warehouse. Web research: Mount Veeder Winery is a Constellation brand whose bulk wine has historically been produced at the shared Franciscan/Galleron Road facility (now The Prisoner Wine Co., idx 6). The Mt Veeder Rd site is a terraced mountain vineyard with one modest estate building. Franciscan Estate brand itself was sold to E&J Gallo in 2021 and is no longer Constellation-owned; Mount Veeder remains with Constellation.
fieldNotes.truckGate: No controlled truck entrance. Access is a narrow one-lane dirt/gravel road off Mount Veeder Road; Street View shows only deer fencing along a rural mountain road, no barrier, no checkpoint.
fieldNotes.guardShack: No staffed booth anywhere on the property.
fieldNotes.dockDoors: No loading docks. Single small estate building with an adjacent dirt yard clearing. No freight-dock rhythm visible.
fieldNotes.drivewayShort: Single short dirt access track from Mount Veeder Road to the building; not built for truck queuing.
fieldNotes.urbanRural: Remote hillside in the Mayacamas Range, surrounded by forest and terraced vineyard, far from town.
fieldNotes.connectivityIssue: Isolated mountain location with heavy tree cover and no nearby development — cellular coverage likely weak. Medium confidence.
fieldNotes.siteAreaAcres: Perimeter is an estimate of the vineyard estate parcel; the built footprint is far smaller.
fieldNotes.buildingCount: One distinct estate building visible; small outbuildings may exist under tree canopy.
